# Henry County Directory

> The premier local business directory for Henry County, Georgia, including McDonough, Stockbridge, Hampton, and Locust Grove. We connect residents with trusted local services, healthcare, dining, and retail.

## About
- [About Us](https://henrycounty.com/about): Our mission and community focus.
- [Contact](https://henrycounty.com/contact): How to reach our team.

## Key Resources
- [Browse Categories](https://henrycounty.com/category): Find local businesses by industry (e.g., Medical, Automotive, Foods, Services).
- [Browse Cities](https://henrycounty.com/city): Explore businesses by city location.
- [Deals & Promotions](https://henrycounty.com/deals): Local discounts and offers.
- [Local Events](https://henrycounty.com/events): Community events calendar.

## For Business Owners
- [Claim Your Business](https://henrycounty.com/claim): Take control of your listing and connect with the community.
- [Add a Listing](https://henrycounty.com/add-listing): Submit a new business to the directory.
